{"action":"shell","command":"cat > /tmp/patch1.py <<'PYEOF'
path = '/testbed/tinydb/journal.py'
s = open(path).read()

old1 = "import copy\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping"
new1 = "import copy\nimport hashlib\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping"
assert old1 in s
s = s.replace(old1, new1)

old2 = "        self._db = db\n        self._table_name = db.default_table_name\n"
new2 = ("        self._db = db\n"
        "        self._table_name = db.default_table_name\n"
        "        # Idempotency-token bookkeeping (R07/R08).  This state\n"
        "        # belongs to *this* BatchWriter instance only; it is never\n"
        "        # written into the database or into user documents.\n"
        "        #\n"
        "        # Maps token -> (fingerprint of the operation list, list\n"
        "        # of the inserted IDs returned by the successful batch).\n"
        "        self._tokens = {}\n")
assert old2 in s
s = s.replace(old2, new2)

old3 = "    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # Public API\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n"
new3 = ("    @classmethod\n"
        "    def _validate_token(cls, token: Optional[str]) -> None:\n"
        "        \"\"\"\n"
        "        Validate an idempotency token (R07).\n"
        "\n"
        "        ``None`` means a normal, non-idempotent operation and is\n"
        "        always valid.  Any other token must be a *nonempty\n"
        "        string*; anything else raises :class:`ValueError`.\n"
        "        \"\"\"\n"
        "\n"
        "        if token is None:\n"
        "            return\n"
        "        if not isinstance(token, str) or not token:\n"
        "            raise ValueError(\n"
        "                'Idempotency token must be a nonempty string, got '\n"
        "                '{!r}'.format(token)\n"
        "            )\n"
        "\n"
        "    @staticmethod\n"
        "    def _fingerprint(operations: list) -> str:\n"
        "        \"\"\"\n"
        "        Compute a stable fingerprint of an operation list.\n"
        "\n"
        "        The fingerprint is used to decide whether a token is being\n"
        "        re-used with the *identical* batch (R07).  It is based on a\n"
        "        canonical JSON serialisation of the (already structurally\n"
        "        validated) operations, so structurally equal batches\n"
        "        produce equal fingerprints.\n"
        "        \"\"\"\n"
        "\n"
        "        import json\n"
        "\n"
        "        return hashlib.sha256(\n"
        "            json.dumps(operations, sort_keys=True,\n"
        "                       separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf-8')\n"
        "        ).hexdigest()\n"
        "\n"
        "    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n"
        "    # Public API\n"
        "    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n")
assert old3 in s
s = s.replace(old3, new3)

open(path, 'w').write(s)
print('patched ok')
PYEOF
python3 /tmp/patch1.py"}
